narr: Strong monsoon thunderstorms caused wind damage in Yavapai County and some flash flooding in northern Coconino County.
ev: Antelope Canyon Tribal Park Service sent photos of water flowing through Antelope Canyon. High water marks indicated water depth of 1 to 2 feet prior to entering Antelope Canyon. Time is estimated.
lsr: Post event report from Sunday evening (8/24). Antelope Canyon Tribal Parks sent photos of water continuing to flow through Antelope Canyon as of 6am Monday morning (8/25). High water marks indicated
